instruction: Within Terminal, you should invoke songsee to produce a multi-panel visualization of "$HOME/Desktop/Ode to Joy.mp3" featuring spectrogram,chroma,tempogram,flux — beginning at 22.5 seconds with a duration of 11.5 seconds, applying the viridis style, dimensions of width 1280 and height 720, a window of 8192, hop of 1024, and a frequency range spanning 60 Hz to 9000 Hz — and finally save the output as a PNG file to "$HOME/Desktop/songsee_combo_3.png".
reference_command: songsee "$HOME/Desktop/Ode to Joy.mp3" --viz spectrogram,chroma,tempogram,flux --start 22.5 --duration 11.5 --style viridis --width 1280 --height 720 --window 8192 --hop 1024 --min-freq 60 --max-freq 9000 --format png -o "$HOME/Desktop/songsee_combo_3.png"
